listening_limit: These new influence recordings are study targets with primary-source context, not completed transcriptions or measured swing templates. The 52 completed excerpt opinions concern original DKC references and remain in evidence/listening_summary.json.
historical_limit: No claim that these named recordings directly influenced DKC1; some postdate 1994. Their transfer principles are project interpretations.

references.title: Rubén González — Mandinga, live at Ronnie Scott’s
references.verified_context: World Circuit supplies the performance link and describes piano leading while maintaining rhythm.
references.study_target: Study a foreground piano phrase that remains connected to the dance pulse. Adapt short answers and clear releases around the preserved DKC melody.

references.title: Buena Vista Social Club — Chan Chan, Pueblo Nuevo and El Cuarto de Tula
references.verified_context: The official album page verifies the titles and credits and describes arrangements developed around individual songs with much ensemble recording live.
references.study_target: Study space around a recurring figure, piano/bass responsibility and the lift from complementary entrances. Keep each tune’s genre distinct; do not turn every DKC cue into a son.

references.title: Orchestra Baobab — Utrus Horas, live at Festival du Bout du Monde
references.verified_context: The label documents Senegalese musicians combining Cuban influence with West African traditions and identifies the intertwining guitar and saxophone introduction of Utrus Horas.
references.study_target: Let a clear hook sit above relaxed, interlocking responses. Create buoyancy through placement, duration and conversational gaps without accelerating the piece.

references.title: AfroCubism — Guantanamera
references.verified_context: World Circuit identifies AfroCubism as a 2010 Malian/Cuban collaboration, with guitar, ngoni, balafon and kora participants and defined improvisational spaces.
references.study_target: Write separate repeating foundations, foreground statements and answering windows. Add kora or balafon only where its tuning and voice complement the DKC source; it is an elective new color.

references.title: Thomas Mapfumo & the Blacks Unlimited — Kuvarira Mukati, live at Africa Calling
references.verified_context: Real World documents adaptation of mbira repertoire into guitar-band music and supplies the named live performance.
references.study_target: Make two sparse, related parts interlock into a larger cycle, retaining each part’s attack and silence. Borrow that arranging principle; do not relabel it Cuban son, Afrobeat or a generic African rhythm.

references.title: Berklee PULSE — Create Your Own Afro-Latin Groove
references.verified_context: Primary teaching material builds 2–3 son clave, cáscara, contrasting pulse, bass and harmony as separate cooperating parts.
references.study_target: For a chosen son-related section, mark the two-measure orientation and count entrances through it. Keep its timeline stable; write complementary strokes before considering microtiming.

references.title: Established performer-specific references
references.verified_context: The current profiles separately anchor Ranglin, Nocentelli/The Meters, Monty Alexander, Porter, Modeliste, Santamaria, Hussain, Mann, Narell, Bonobo and five guests.
references.study_target: Use the profile’s named instrument-specific reference and physical vocabulary; Bonobo remains the single primary producer identity. Historical artists are reference points, not participants.
